svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The browser sends HTTPS for www.customer.com. OpenResty reads only the SNI name, finds the VM in its SNI map, and sends the unchanged TLS stream to port 443 on the VM with a PROXY protocol v2 header that carries the client address. The VM holds the certificate.
